en: A monochrome vintage postcard showing a tall, narrow brick tower attached to a gabled building with a tiled roof. Leafless pruned trees and hedges stand in front of the structure, with a small gate and pathway leading toward it. The style is historic Flemish. The caption at the top identifies the scene as 'Bruges — La Gilde St-Sébastien.' Additional small text appears along the bottom edge.
